Lines.en: More torches and nunchucks! We still can't get powerful plant partners from this time-space turbulence.
Lines.zh: 又是火棍和双节棍！我们还没办法从这时空乱流中拿到强力的植物伙伴！

Lines.en: Don't be discouraged, user Dave, where there's a will, there's a way!
Lines.zh: 不要沮丧，用户戴夫，天无绝人之路！

Lines.en: Monks aren't good at holding their breath, and tanglekelp can entangle them in the water cube of aquavines!
Lines.zh: 武僧们并不擅长憋气，水草可以把他们缠入水生藤蔓的水立方里。

Lines.en: This way, we can make them lose their fighting ability!!
Lines.zh: 这样就可以让他们丧失战斗能力啦！

Lines.en: Let those nunchuck-wielding monks who just stepped onto the field taste some 'watery' jelly!
Lines.zh: 让那些刚踏入场地的双截棍武僧们尝尝水果冻的滋味吧！
